about.heritageStory: Founded with a passion for authentic culinary traditions and flawless hospitality, AD Catering & Cook Services has grown to become Odisha's premier choice for festive, corporate, and royal wedding celebrations. Our culinary repertoire blends the deep-rooted richness of traditional Odia delicacies—such as slow-cooked Dalma, Machha Besara, Mutton Kasa, and earthen-baked Chhena Poda—with pan-Indian royal banquets, live Chinese woks, and European pastry dessert lounges.
